versions.content:
[SWS_PHM_01333] Termination of Supervised Processes
⌈
As soon as
Platform Health Management receives the information from Execution Manage-
ment that a supervised process is about to be notified to terminate (by issuing
SIGTERM) or the process is terminated (considering the case of process terminat- ing abruptly, i.e.
without SIGTERM issued by Execution Management), Platform
Health Management shall stop all intra-process supervisions corresponding to the
process (that is stop all Alive, Deadline and Logical Supervision involving Supervi-
sionCheckpoints of the corresponding process only).
⌋
